def.brief: Fix Q-gitlink in dwitbuk.py's source_state only: in the tracked traversal (the git ls-files loop), an entry git itself reports as a gitlink (index mode 160000, e.g. from git ls-files --stage) is marked with a trailing / before it is tested as a record — the same marker the status loop already gives untracked and ignored directories — so a nested repository at a bare exact-file declaration such as custom-record.json is source, while one under a directory declaration (custom-dir/) and a regular file at a bare declaration stay excluded. The type comes from git's report, not from is_record looking at the disk; is_record and every other site stay as they are, and mangsang/ still counts for freshness. No other change. test_dwitbuk.py is the contract and protected: do not edit it, hooks/stop_eyes.py, README.md, the manifests, eyes_worker.py or hostcall.py, and do not commit. Run the suite with AGENT_WORKER unset (env -u AGENT_WORKER python3 test_dwitbuk.py): inside a worker session test_session_start_hook_says_what_the_placed_reviews_still_need_and_nothing_else fails only because that hook steps aside when AGENT_WORKER=1.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded source_state gitlink fix. The suite has one failure caused by a repeated identical write in a protected test.
non-claims: The full suite does not pass. Protected tests were not edited; implementation changes are confined to source_state in dwitbuk.py.

disputed-tests.why: The second gitlink_stales call writes the same child.py contents already present when the fresh answer was bound, yet expects source changed. Passing this assertion would require changing the existing content-fingerprint behavior to invalidate an identical-content rewrite.
